name: Brace
description: You draw a deep breath, steeling yourself for the struggle ahead.
effects: You gain 3 stacks of Protected.

name: Soulblade
description: Through mystical training, force of will, or some other mental regimen you have unlocked the ability to forge your spiritual force into a solid weapon.
effects: When you learn this, choose a specific type of weapon. For 0 AP at any time you can create a weapon of the chosen type, appearing in your hand(s). If the weapon leaves your hands it disappears; if thrown it disappears after striking its target.

name: Temper Soulblade
description: As you learn lessons they are etched into your soul, and as you express your spiritual weaponry its form changes to reflect your newfound wisdom.
effects: When you learn this, choose a Masterwork power (GM approval). This Technique's Level equals the chosen Masterwork's Level. When you create a weapon with Soulblade, you may choose one Masterwork power from this Technique that could apply; the weapon is created with it. Can be 're-purchased' at a higher Level by paying the XP difference.

name: Vow of Poverty
description: You have forsworn all forms of material excess and wealth, and vowed to give all you can to the needy.
effects: You may not own luxury items or keep more than 10 Gold. When you donate to a worthy cause, gain 1 XP per 7 Gold donated. Breaking the vow gives Bad Luck on Presence/Persuasion/Rapport flips and prevents donation XP until you atone by donating 30 Gold worth.

name: Blindsight
description: By learning to effectively use echolocation, feel the motion of air against your skin, or honing multiple senses, you are capable of navigating in total darkness.
effects: You are aware of everything within [Awareness Skill Total] meters as though you could see it (color and facial features are difficult). Does not require an action. Reduced through solid objects but you still sense basic details.

name: Blood-Powered Spirit
description: Mastering the power within your own blood, you can draw it forth to power your spirit when your energy begins to wane.
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you declare a Spell or Discipline Technique)
effects: Choose one: (a) Any attack from the Technique deals extra X damage if it hits, or [twice X] if single-target; if damage type is Fire/Frost/Brilliant you may change it to Shadow. (b) If the Technique's Level is [twice X] or lower, you may cast it without expending a use, even if already expended.

name: Bound Across Mountains
description: Extensive practice in leaping and bounding has trained you to hurl yourself over truly vast obstacles.
effects: Your maximum jump distance is doubled in both directions. When falling, you may reduce damage taken by your Athletics Skill Total instead of another stat.

name: Canopy Creeper
description: Your limbs are strong and agile enough that you can traverse vertical distances as easily as you do horizontal ones.
effects: You may move at your full Speed while climbing without flips, as long as your hands are free. You may climb across any surface with some texture. While not moving you may hold your position on such a surface with only your feet.

name: Falling Tumble
description: With perfect balance you can easily turn the momentum from a fall into a nimble roll.
effects: When falling, you may reduce damage taken by your Acrobatics Skill Total instead of another stat. At the end of such a fall, you may Shift up to [the fall's height] meters.

name: Grim Resolve
description: When you get backed into a corner, you push yourself to your absolute limits to do what needs to be done.
effects: You draw a card.

name: One Eye Behind You
description: It's not paranoia if you're actually being followed... and even if you're not, it's good to keep an eye out.
effects: You have Good Luck on Reflex flips. At any time, you may discard a card to adjust your position in turn order by up to [half your Insight Skill Total] places.

name: Second Wind
description: Even when you've been battered and bruised, you catch your breath and keep pushing forward.
effects: You heal 1 Shallow Health, or 2 if the discarded card was a Heart.

name: Solemn Pact
description: You have sworn a pact — a pledge of fealty to a mysterious entity, or a dedication to a set of ideals.
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you make a flip of the chosen type with the chosen Skill)
effects: When you learn this, choose a Skill and either attack or non-attack flips (e.g. 'Melee attack flips'). You gain Good Luck twice on the flip. If you break your pact (GM's discretion), you lose benefits until you atone or find a new pact.

name: Toughened Body
description: Through physical prowess or sheer determination, you have trained your body to withstand more abuse than most.
effects: Increase your maximum Deep Health by 3.

name: Trout Seeming
description: You were born to swim, taking to the water like a natural.
effects: You may swim or move through water at your full Speed. While swimming, you may jump out of water as though it were solid ground. You have Good Luck twice on flips to hold your breath.

name: Skin of Stone
description: You briefly strengthen your body, allowing your extremely sturdy physical form to take a tremendous assault with almost no harm.
effects: You gain 1 + [half your Resilience Skill Total] stacks of Protected.

name: Solemn Perseverance
description: "I am your loyal servant, my master. Failure is not an option..."
effects: After the first time you lose Health each encounter, you gain: Protected 3 times; remove up to 2 total stacks of your choice of Bleeding/Crippled/Frightened/Slowed/Taunted/Vulnerable from yourself. Breaking your pact removes these benefits until atonement.

name: Strength from the Slain
description: Many barbarian tribes practice the ritual of eating the hearts of enemy warriors slain in combat.
target: An adjacent humanoid Downed this encounter by you or an ally
effects: You remove and eat the target's heart (usually killing them instantly if still alive). You gain: sustained as from a full meal; Hasted and Protected 3 times each; once this encounter Good Luck on one Athletics/Brawl/Melee/Might/Presence/Resilience flip.

name: Toughened Resolve
description: Pushing yourself to your physical limits, when victory rests on a knife's edge you refuse to falter.
effects: Increase your maximum Shallow and Deep Health each by 2.

name: Lay On Hands
target: Yourself or an adjacent willing creature
effects: Do each in order: 1. Reduce effects of each Poison as though an hour passed. 2. Remove up to 2 stacks of Bleeding. 3. Target heals 1 Health, or 2 if the discarded card was a Heart.

name: Mind and Body Unbroken
effects: You are not Downed. Instead you have 1 Shallow and 1 Deep Health remaining.

name: Solemn Covenant
description: (Extended oath: to be kind, to be strong, to be good — see full rules text)
effects: At the start of each encounter, you gain 4 Covenant points. When you use an Encounter Technique, you may pay [that Technique's Level] Covenant points to not expend a use of it. Breaking your pact removes these benefits until atonement.

name: Toughened Spirit
description: Your resilience is legendary, a silhouette moving tirelessly through the fires of adversity and emerging unscathed.
effects: Increase your maximum Shallow Health by 5.

name: Artisanal Training
description: Through a formal apprenticeship or independent study, you have refined your craft enough to produce finished goods.
effects: Each time you learn this, choose a creation School: Smithing, Carving, Tailoring, Jewelrymaking, Alchemy, or Cooking. You are trained in crafting using the chosen School.
prereqs: Craft 2 (if Smithing/Carving/Tailoring/Jewelrymaking) or Mixology 2 (if Alchemy/Cooking) or Survival 2 (if Cooking)

name: Extensive Background
description: You benefit from a wealth of training and practice early in life, steeping you in the culture and skills of your upbringing.
effects: Each time you learn this, choose a new background from either the General list or your specific list (Settler or Wildfolk).

name: Practiced Persona
description: After some time adopting disguises and alternate identities, you have constructed a favorite persona for certain situations.
effects: Each time you learn this, choose a new persona (fake identity; may not be a real person; must have standard appearance, occupation, habits, and background). You have Good Luck on flips to disguise yourself or act as your persona.

name: Profession
description: You benefit from basic training in a practice or profession, giving you solid fundamentals in a valuable skill.
effects: Each time you learn this, choose one profession: Apothecary, Artisan, Busker, Fisher, Gatherer, Grifter, Merchant, Sailor, Tactician, or Theologian. Each grants Good Luck on relevant flips. See rules for each option's specific benefit and prereq.

name: Ventriloquy
description: The art of disguise is less about how you look, but rather how others hear and see you.
effects: When using Masquerade to disguise your voice, you may instead make the flip as a Masquerade attack against the Insight Defense of all onlookers. Each target hit falls for the vocal disguise and believes it came from an object or space within twice [your Masquerade skill total] spaces. On a miss, target recognizes the inauthenticity but is unsure of its source.

name: Air of Mystery
description: People find it hard to remember exactly who you were or what you were doing just a bit ago.
effects: While disguised, if someone sees through your disguise they cannot determine your actual identity, just that you're an imposter. Onlookers will not remember your involvement in any event unless you directly interacted with them memorably; even then they have Bad Luck on flips to draw conclusions.

name: Animal Companion
description: "This old girl? Found her hurt in the woods a few seasons back, nursed her back to health."
effects: You train an animal, making it your Animal Companion. The animal must be willing/tamed; training usually takes a full day. Once official, it behaves as Summoned. You can only have one animal companion at a time; training a new one breaks the bond with the old.

name: Animal Companion: Trick
description: "You know, I really wish your wolf would stop slobbering into our mugs."
effects: Your companion learns one trick: Civilized (manipulate objects like a small child), Determination (+1 max Shallow and Deep Health each), Trained (one Skill Total = [your Survival ST] - 2), Quick (+2 Speed, once only), Martial Training (learn a Level 1 Battle Maneuver), or Beast Feast [Encounter] (eat heart of downed enemy, heal 2 Health). Apply to whichever animal is your companion.

name: Awaken Armament
description: The weapons and armor that you craft hold secrets and potential that you can unlock.
target: An item you personally crafted, which you are touching
effects: Choose a Masterwork enhancement you know of Level X or lower. The target item gains that enhancement until you get a full night's rest. The enhancement must be one you could normally create.

name: Hand of the Chirurgeon
description: With a great amount of practice and knowledge you have learned the fundamentals of medicine.
target: Yourself or a willing humanoid patient adjacent to you
effects: Remove up to [half your Medicine Skill Total] stacks of Bleeding from the target.

name: Legerdemain
description: As a practiced thief and tinkerer, you have trained in manual dexterity enough that you can bypass locks and swipe valuables easily and without a trace.
effects: Picking a lock never takes more than 4 AP. You may treat any rigid object that fits in the keyhole as a lockpick. When you successfully steal through sleight of hand, onlookers have Bad Luck on flips to notice its absence for the encounter. When you fail to pick a pocket, neither victim nor onlookers know who is responsible.

name: Mighty Mixologist
description: Familiar with the principles and practical applications of your alchemical creations, you know how to maximize their effectiveness.
effects: When you attack with a damaging Grenade item of Level 3 or lower, it deals +1 damage. If your Body is lower than 5, you may treat it as 1 higher for Grenade attack range. Whenever you use a Poison created with Mixology, its Concentration becomes +[your Mixology Skill Total] if it would be lower.

name: Patch Up
description: With a strong foundation of practical medicine, your tender care and efficient bandaging ensure that your traveling companions are kept in good shape.
cost: Discard a card or use 1 Medicinal Supply
target: Up to [half your Medicine Skill Total] humanoid patients
effects: All targets who get a full night's rest immediately after being treated heal an extra Health. A creature can only benefit from this Technique once per rest.

name: Placeholder's Alacritous Adaptation
description: (Extended literary quote from Arcanists of Myth and Legend, Vol. IV)
cost: Expend the use of any number of Discipline/Martial/Spell Encounter Techniques
effects: You regain the use of one Discipline, Martial, or Spell Encounter Technique. The regained Technique's Level must be lower than the total Levels of Techniques you expended as a cost.

name: Practical Necromancy
description: Well-learned in practical applications of your magic, you have learned to do more than simply raise corpses.
effects: When creating an item, you may replace any Metal or Wood in its Base Materials with Bone; for such items you may use Carving instead of Smithing. If you know Raise Corpse, items you create this way may be animated as a Reanimated Corpse substitute, powered by your magic.

name: Quick Draw
description: You have an uncanny knack for always having just what you need right at hand and having quick fingers readying your equipment.
effects: It takes you 0 AP to retrieve or store an item, regardless of location, although it must still be within reach.

name: Re-purpose Materials
description: While many craftsmen can work with prepared materials you have a more pragmatic approach and are a deft hand at rendering finished products into serviceable materials.
effects: You may break down existing items into raw materials. Produces materials of Types matching the Base and Extra Materials of the item, split evenly (GM decides). If you created the item, you receive those exact material Types. All materials produced are of the item's Level.

name: Scrapcraft
description: You are in the habit of keeping a variety of half-completed spare parts in your pack, and in the practice of making common items from various odds and ends.
effects: You create a non-Masterwork item with Craft as its relevant Skill, whose School/Skill/recipe requirements you meet. All required materials must be within reach. The item stays together as long as you keep this Technique committed, then falls apart into the materials used.

name: Shadow's Path
description: A phantom in the shadows, the art of stealth comes so naturally to you that you can easily guide your allies while remaining hidden.
effects: You have Good Luck on Stealth checks to sneak into or out of places. In a group Stealth check, you may flip first; you may Gamble, gaining [Spades] extra successes. For each success, you may give an ally Good Luck on their Stealth flip. You may not benefit someone also using this Technique.

name: Street Runner
description: With a keen eye for the layout of alleys, tunnels, and bakeries, you know how to move through a city both unfettered and well-fed.
effects: You have Good Luck on Streetwise flips to navigate and travel through settlements at least as large as a town. Once per day in an urban environment, you automatically find water for the party and food for [half your Streetwise Skill Total] people (must be consumed immediately; Level 1 Food equivalent).

name: Wisdom of the Woods
description: "Tryin' to make the trek north to Rivera?..."
effects: You have Good Luck when using Survival to Scout or Search outdoors, or when Assisting others with Survival. Others have Good Luck when Assisting on your Survival flips. If your Survival flip has at least one Heart in the pool, you recall an interesting fact relevant to the flip.

name: Analyze Stance
description: "Based on how far down the handle he's holding his sword..."
target: A creature you can see
effects: The next attack against the target's Dodge or Parry Defense made by you or someone you choose has Good Luck. Then, make an Academics attack against the target's Instinct Defense. If it hits, gain [Spades] Extra Successes, then learn one of the following per success: Parry/Dodge Defense and Harried stacks; Accuracy and Damage with wielded weapons; Physical Resist; Fire/Frost/Brilliant/Shadow Resists; Vital/Mental/Instinct Defenses and Vulnerable stacks.

name: Artisan's Eye
description: Your discerning eye sees all when it comes to your craft.
target: A created/crafted item, or a schematic/recipe
effects: You understand all of the target item's statistics as though you had flipped a 13 to analyze it, including materials. If you meet the skill requirements to create the item, you permanently learn it as a recipe.

name: Bespoke Masterpieces
description: While other artisans make impressive accessories and armaments, they're all cast from the same mold.
effects: You can use Masterwork items you personally created as base items when creating new Masterwork items. The item retains previous enhancements and gains the new one in addition. This increases the item's Level by that of the new enhancement; you may not raise an item's Level past 6 this way. You cannot give an item an enhancement it already has.

name: Environmental Esoterica
description: "How on earth did you find a sealed bottle of rum in the desert?..."
effects: When using Survival to Scout or Search in the outdoors, you may treat your [NOTE: effects text is incomplete in source document — to be completed].

name: Gather the Evidence
description: "We're clearly missing something here..."
cost: Discard a card (if used on the same subject before)
effects: Choose a subject to gain knowledge about. Make an Academics flip with Good Luck against a hidden difficulty. On success, you learn something useful about the subject. If something prevents you from gaining the information, you learn exactly what that obstacle is and how it relates to the topic.

name: Optimize Blood
description: By assessing the patient's pulse, bloodflow, and overall bodily state, you can determine how best to improve their short-term health and promote functions like clotting.
cost: Discard a card or use 1 Medicinal Supply
target: Yourself or a willing humanoid patient adjacent to you
effects: For the next [half your Medicine Skill Total] Health the target would lose, instead they gain that many stacks of Bleeding. This effect lasts until the target gets a full night's rest.

name: Preparation
description: The old saying goes "an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure".
effects: You retroactively reveal that you had made preparations useful in your current situation. These must be ordinary steps you could have plausibly taken previously. Examples: stashing supplies in a hidden cache, having sent a letter, having researched a topic. Preparations that cost Gold require you to pay that Gold now. GM decides validity.

name: Vanish
description: With a smoke bomb, great wave of a cloak, or some other obscuring act, you vanish from sight.
target: All onlookers who can see you
effects: Make a Stealth attack against the Instinct Defense of each target. If it hits, the target cannot see you for 1 round or until you declare an attack against them. After this time you may hide as normal, with targets alerted to your likely presence.
special: You may discard a card at any time to regain a use of this Technique.

name: Bottomless Bottles
description: Each week your fingers are stained a different color from different alchemical reagents.
effects: You create items with a total Gold cost of no more than [4 times X], requiring no materials. Items must have Mixology as their Relevant Skill and you must meet all creation requirements. These items last until you get a full night's rest, then fade away.

name: One of Many Faces
description: You have mastered the art of infiltration and imitation.
condition: You are not being observed by anyone
effects: Instantly assume a disguise with Masquerade as though you flipped a 13, but as a generic nondescript person. While in this disguise, you have Good Luck on Masquerade flips, and for 2 AP in a social contest you may make a Strategic statement using Masquerade.

name: Pressure Point Revitalization
description: Thanks to your almost encyclopedic knowledge of the human(oid) body, you can tell at a glance where someone's life force pools.
target: A willing humanoid patient adjacent to you
effects: Make a Medicine flip with difficulty 11. If you succeed, gain 1 extra success for each 2 you beat the difficulty by; X = total successes. Your target may discard up to X cards, then heals 1 Health for each card discarded, plus 1 Health for each unique suit among cards discarded.

name: Preternatural Reflexes
description: You keep your razor sharp wits about you at all times, and you react to danger the instant it presents itself.
effects: When a combat begins, if there would not normally be a surprise round (or you would not be included in one), instead there is a surprise round and you are part of it (3 AP only). You are always aware of attacks against your Dodge or Parry Defense.

name: Social Maneuver
effects: Make a Strategic statement using Presence, Persuasion, or Rapport against a target in the social contest. When you learn this, choose features that apply (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 2 basic; Level 2: 4 basic; Level 3: 6 basic/advanced; Level 4: 8 basic/advanced.

name: Challenge
description: You bellow out a challenge to an enemy, drawing their attention away from your allies and forcing them to face you.
target: A hostile creature within [Presence Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Presence attack against the target's Mental Defense. If the attack hits, you Taunt the target 5 + [Hearts] times.
special: You may expend this during a social contest (while in the front, when you succeed on a Charismatic statement) to Taunt the target once.

name: Follower
description: You have gained the trust and loyalty of a squire, apprentice, familiar, or other follower who helps you on your adventures.
effects: You gain a follower (GM-controlled but loyal). They: are trustworthy and communicate with you; have Skill Total 0 for all actions but can carry a small pack; cannot participate in combat and will flee from danger. If you part ways, you may gain a similar or new follower.

name: Follower: Knack
description: Your heroics and expertise have pushed your follower to follow in your footsteps, developing their own abilities.
effects: Choose one knack for your follower: Contraband Handler (hide small objects), Strong Shoulders (carry heavy loads), Medical Training (+1 Health healed per rest while tending), Squire (hand weapon to ally for 1 AP), Magical Adept (minor magic, once/encounter extend your Spell range by 5), Scavenger (find Level 1 material per day), Performer (earn info or social benefit while in civilization), Guild Member (do official business on your behalf).

name: A Perfectly Good Explanation
description: "You understand that taking anything without permission is thievery, and punishable by law, yes?"
effects: Whenever your party would gain Concessions in a social contest, as many times as you like you may discard a card and reduce those Concessions by 3 (or 4 if you discarded a Heart).

name: Cry of Victory
description: As you strike down an enemy you bellow out, shaking your foes to their bones and causing them to briefly hesitate.
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you Down a hostile creature)
target: Any number of hostile creatures within [Presence Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Presence attack against the Mental Defense of each target. You Frighten each target hit 2 + [Hearts] times.
special: You may expend this during a social contest (while in front, when you succeed on a Charismatic statement) to Frighten the target once.

name: Favorite Face
description: Whether it's your good looks, winning smile, or overall pleasant demeanor, people always seem to view you in a better light.
effects: You never suffer penalties for being a new or unfamiliar face in social situations. If your first statement in a social contest uses Rapport, it has Good Luck. If your party wins a social contest and chooses Disrespect, neither the other party nor onlookers will view your party poorly — they view you with sympathy and may grant Good Luck.

name: Heroic Inspiration
description: Invoking tales of great warriors, you wash away your comrades' worries and concern and push them to battle.
target: Any number of allies who can see or hear you
effects: Choose one of the following, [half your Performance Skill Total] times: a target is Protected twice (plus once per extra time targeted); remove a stack of Taunted or Frightened from a target; a target may adjust their position in turn order by 1.

name: Rumormonger
description: You have a knack for gossip that borders on concerning, but which proves very useful whenever you need to gently fan the winds of a social situation.
effects: You have Good Luck on Streetwise flips to spread rumors and change opinions. Successful rumors spread to the immediate venue within an hour, then spread further each day. You also have Good Luck on flips to gather information about the rumor after the fact. Once per social contest, you can leverage the rumor for Good Luck twice on a social statement (if relevant and believed).

name: Bolstering Refrain
description: Your words and songs uplift your allies, pushing away their weariness and straightening their backs to fight anew.
target: Up to [half your Performance Skill Total] allies who can see or hear you
effects: Each target heals 1 Shallow Health.

name: Exert Pressure
description: Standing strong, looming over your foes in combat, your presence in a pitched melee is impossible to ignore.
target: Any number of creatures within 2 meters of you
effects: Make a Presence attack against the Mental Defense of each target. You taunt each target hit 3 + [Hearts] times.
special: You may expend this during a social contest (while in front, when you succeed on a Charismatic statement) to Taunt every member of the other party once.

name: Dominate Mind
description: A seemingly innocuous argument or remark serves as the vehicle for a powerful enchantment.
effects: Make a Strategic statement using Theurgy instead of the usual Skill. If the statement succeeds and your party ultimately wins the social contest, that person is dominated for the rest of the current encounter. At the start of each subsequent encounter you may Pitch a card to extend the effect. While dominated, the person treats anything you say as from a close trusted friend and will follow reasonable requests. Once the effect ends, they believe they acted of their own free will.
special: Pitch a card at start of each encounter to extend the domination effect.

name: Raise Spirits
description: No one person can do everything, but if you believe in your friends then you can accomplish anything.
effects: You may always use Performance to Assist an ally (even when it makes little sense), with Good Luck on the flip. For 1 AP as an interrupt when an ally within [Performance Skill Total] meters declares an attack, you may give them Good Luck on the attack.

name: Rally to Victory
description: In every great war story, when the battle is grim and the army is on the brink of defeat a hero will rise above the masses and inspire them to victory.
cost: Discard a card for each target
target: Any number of willing allies who can see or hear you
effects: Each target Sifts X cards (X = [half your Performance Skill Total]), then discards up to X cards, then draws a card for each one discarded.

name: The Gatekeeper
description: "Your entire division was defeated by that band of rebels?..."
target: Any number of creatures who can see or hear you
effects: Make a Presence attack against the Mental Defense of each target. You Taunt each target hit an infinite number of times. These stacks are removed at the end of the encounter.

name: Battle Maneuver
description: The foundation of martial training, every military recruit and self-taught fighter learns how to attack in many strategic ways, knocking opponents off-guard and carving the way for victory.
effects: Make a weapon attack. When you learn this, choose features that apply to the attack (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 3 basic; Level 2: 6 basic; Level 3: 9 basic/advanced; Level 4: 12 basic/advanced.

name: Bladeslinging
description: By adopting an unorthodox grip on your weapon, you can balance it in a way that allows you to leverage a greatsword with only one arm or throw the entire weight of your body behind a small blade.
effects: You may change how you wield a close-range weapon (0 AP, like drawing/sheathing). Wielding a one-handed weapon with two hands makes it two-handed (+1 damage). Wielding a two-handed weapon one-handed makes it one-handed (-1 damage).

name: Feint
effects: Make a weapon attack against the target's Instinct Defense. Instead of normal effects, if it hits then the target is Harried 3 + [Diamonds] times.

name: Magehunter
description: Through multi-disciplinary training in magical practice, you have learned when spellcasters leave gaps in their defenses and how to exploit those weaknesses.
action: 1 AP - Interrupt (a creature within your weapon's range declares a Spell, before it is cast)
target: The creature trying to cast a Spell
effects: Make a weapon attack against the target. You may use a Technique instead, as long as it has you make a weapon attack against the target and takes no more than 2 AP to use.

name: Parting Shot
description: By keeping a keen eye on the flow of battle, you can punish enemies who try to disengage from you.
action: 1 AP - Interrupt (a creature within range of a close-range weapon you are wielding would move or be Pushed outside your range)
target: The creature trying to move or being Pushed
effects: Make an attack with a close-range weapon against the target. You may use a Technique instead, as long as it has you make a weapon attack with a close-range weapon against the target and takes no more than 2 AP.

name: Blinkstep
description: With a quick, fluid motion you dance around your enemies.
effects: Shift up to [half your Acrobatics Skill Total] meters.

name: Perfect Strike
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you declare a weapon attack)
effects: You have Good Luck on the weapon attack, then choose one: have Good Luck a second time on the attack; or add the discarded card to the attack's suit pool.

name: Cloak and Dagger
description: "Lord Radcliffe! How did you manage to convince the boss of that criminal gang to stop interfering in our trade routes?..."
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you declare a weapon attack with a close-range weapon that isn't Heavy or two-handed)
effects: Make a Stealth attack against the Instinct Defense of a target of the weapon attack (Good Luck if you discarded a Spade). If it hits, that target is unaware of the attack. You may not use this against a target more than once per attack.

name: Shugen Style - Spirit Bolt
description: An initiate of the spiritual arts learns to direct their energy into tangible bolts directed at their enemies.
target: A creature within [Meditation Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Meditation attack against the target's Dodge Defense. If the attack hits, it deals 3 + [Mind] Brilliant damage.

name: Bear Style - Boulder Toss
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you hit with an attack to grapple a creature)
target: The creature you grappled
effects: End the grapple and throw the target up to [half your Might Skill Total] meters in a straight line. If thrown into a sturdy object, the target strikes it (3 + [your Body] Physical damage to both). If thrown through a creature's space, make a Might attack against that creature's Dodge; if it hits they are struck for the same damage. Target lands in front of the obstacle.

name: Channel Ki
description: (Extended quote from Arcanists of Myth and Legend, Vol. I about the ancient master Kodai)
action: X AP (X must be [half your Meditation Skill Total] or less)
effects: Regain the use of an Encounter Technique with a Level of X or less.

name: Demon Style - Plague Fist
description: A corruption of traditional hand-to-hand ki maneuvers, you twist your victim's spirit and desecrate their life force.
effects: Make an Unarmed weapon attack which deals its damage as Shadow. If the attack hits, before damage is dealt, the target gains [half your Meditation Skill Total] + [Spades] stacks of Necrotic, then [half your Meditation Skill Total] + [Diamonds] stacks of Vulnerable.

name: Ignore Pain
description: Fighting styles and magics that induce weakness in the body frequently rely on exploiting simple yet effective pressure points.
effects: Remove up to [half your Meditation Skill Total] total stacks of Crippled and/or Slowed from yourself.

name: Pranic Nourishment
description: You can tune your body into the metaphysical weave of your surroundings, sustaining yourself off of the energy of the world around you.
effects: You only need to meditate for half an hour to get a full night's rest, and heal an extra 1 Health per rest. You do not need to eat or drink. You may eat almost anything safely. Effectively immune to ingested poisons; does not prevent intoxication but prevents extreme harmful effects like alcohol poisoning.

name: Shugen Style - Iron Skin
description: As an attack weaves its way past your guard, you concentrate your energy into your skin to deflect the force of the blow.
action: 2 AP - Interrupt (you are hit by an attack, before the attack is resolved)
effects: You gain [half your Meditation Skill Total] stacks of Protected.

name: Shugen Style - Through the Void
description: Just as water rushes to fill an empty vessel, by regulating the flow of your ki you can pull your physical being through space to another's.
target: A creature within [Meditation Skill Total] meters
effects: Teleport to any empty space adjacent to the target. You may then make a Meditation attack against the target's Mental Defense; if it hits, the target Teleports into the space you were originally in.

name: Snake Style - Heelbiter
description: When an enemy tries to disengage from combat you creep around them and trip up their movement, steadily constricting them.
condition: Your hands are empty, and you are unarmored
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (a creature within range of your Unarmed weapon attempts to move away or be Pushed away from you)
target: The creature trying to move or being Pushed
effects: Make an Unarmed weapon attack against that creature. If it hits, the creature does not move or is not Pushed; their movement for that action or effect is Countered.

name: Snake Style - Chainbreaker
description: (Extended quote about Master Raha who freed a labor camp using his chains as weapons)
condition: Your hands are empty, and you are unarmored
action: 1 AP - Interrupt (a weapon attack flip is made targeting only you against your Parry Defense, before its effects are resolved)
target: A creature within range of the attack, or the attacker
effects: Make an Unarmed weapon attack flip; its result becomes X. Your Parry Defense against the attack becomes X. If you Parry it, the attack is instead made against the target you chose as though it had a flip result of X, then resolved normally.

name: Corrupted Blood
description: One belief that many civilizations across the land share is that, for a variety of reasons, they consider blood to be important, even sacred.
effects: Choose Bloody, Necrotic, Vulnerability, or Psychosis Poison; create a fresh dose with Concentration +X and Potency [half X] (X = your Meditation Skill Total). Extra +1 Potency if matching suit was Pitched (Clubs/Bloody, Spades/Necrotic, Diamonds/Vulnerability, Hearts/Psychosis). Spend 1 AP to coat a weapon instead. You are immune to this poison. After a full rest, the poison loses potency.

name: Shugen Style - Fist of the Third Dragon
description: By studying the wisdom and technique of the dragons, acolytes have learned how to channel power in unusual and impressive ways.
target: All creatures in a 3-meter-cone from you
effects: Make a Meditation attack against each target's Mental Defense. The attack deals 1 + [Mind] Brilliant damage. If it hits, you Frighten the target 3 + [Hearts] times and Slow the target 3 + [Spades] times.

name: Snake Style - Turn the Tables
description: With a certain limb-lock you can twist a creature you are grappling in the way of oncoming blows.
condition: Your hands are empty, and you are unarmored
action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you successfully grapple a creature)
target: The creature you grappled
effects: You use the target as a shield until the grapple ends. You may Parry with them as a Brawl weapon (Defense +0). If you successfully Parry an attack with the target, the attack instead targets their Parry Defense and is resolved accordingly.

name: Harmonious Mending
description: Bringing your physical and spiritual being into alignment, you restore harmony to your body as well as re-balance your energies.
cost: Discard X cards (maximum [half your Meditation Skill Total])
effects: Do each in order: 1. Reduce effects of each poison as though X hours passed. 2. Heal X + [Hearts discarded] Health. 3. Remove a stack of Bleeding per Club discarded, Necrotic per Spade, Vulnerable per Diamond, and Frightened or Taunted per Heart discarded.

name: Conjure Armament
description: You conjure a weapon. Or maybe a suit of armor. You know, whatever you're feeling at the time.
action: 1 AP (or free as part of declaring an attack)
target: Yourself, an ally, or a space within [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: Conjure up to X weapons, armor, or ammunition of a type you choose. Functions as regular equipment; lasts until dismissed. You may have no more than X conjured (X = times you know this Spell). When declaring an attack, you may cast this as part of that action (0 extra AP) to conjure a weapon for that attack only.

name: Placeholder's Tender Telekinesis
description: One of the most prominent of Placeholder's legendary incantations — a favorite of practical magicians and magical instructors alike.
target: An object no heavier than 5 kg or up to 1 liter of liquid, within [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters. One target per time you know this Spell.
effects: Conjure a magical force to move the target object(s), allowing manipulation up to [your Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters. Complex use costs 1 extra AP and requires relevant Skill flips. May not be used to attack. If you stop casting or spend a turn without casting, objects fall.

name: Placeholder's Wizardly Witchlight
description: Another classic spell attributed to the arcanist pseudonym Placeholder — a staple of the practical arcanist.
effects: Create a flame that fits in your empty hand, casting up to torchlight in any color you choose. Gently warm to your touch; affects others as a normal flame. Lasts until you use the hand, lose consciousness, or dismiss it. You may make it ethereal (only you see it) at will; spend 1 AP to toggle.

name: Shadow Jaunt
description: Your form flickers into absolute darkness, and in the blink of an eye you fade from view and reappear somewhere else.
effects: You Teleport up to [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters.

name: Raise Corpse
description: The cornerstone of popular necromancy and a timeless classic, this spell binds magical power into a dead body to animate it under your command.
target: A pile of humanoid remains within [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: You Summon the target remains as a Reanimated Corpse. You may control up to [Mind] corpses at a time; if you exceed this limit, the oldest corpse is de-animated. Larger/smaller corpses count proportionally toward your limit.

name: Ritual Magic
description: An ancient practice from times of less refined spellcasting — certain magical techniques allow multiple casters to pool their energies to empower a single ritual.
effects: Whenever you could discard cards for a cost or effect of one of your Spells, a willing ally within [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters may discard any number of those cards instead of you. Treat those cards as though you had discarded them yourself.

name: Spellblade
description: Your practice with both sorcery and martial combat has given you the ability to seamlessly integrate magic with your swordplay.
cost: Expend the use of a Spell Encounter Technique; X is its Level
effects: Choose one option then make a weapon attack. General options: range +[6×X] meters; Push [6×X]+[Spades] meters; target gains [3×X]+[Clubs] Bleeding; you gain [3×X]+1+[Hearts] Fire/Frost/Shadow Ward. Sorcery options: target Slowed [3×X]+[Spades]; Vulnerable [3×X]+[Diamonds]; Necrotic [3×X]+[Diamonds]. Theurgy options: Shift [6×X]+[Clubs] meters; Protected [3×X]+1+[Spades]; target Crippled [3×X]+[Clubs].

name: Summon Slime
description: You meld residual matter with ambient spiritual or elemental energies, creating a mindless animated blob you can guide with your magic.
target: An empty space within [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: You create a Summoned Slime in the target space, lasting for the encounter. When cast, you may commit this Spell; if you do, the Slime lasts as long as you keep this Spell committed after the scene ends.

name: Telepathic Link
description: "What does this weird spell do again?..."
target: Yourself and/or any number of allies you touch, up to [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] creatures per time you know this Spell
effects: All targets are linked and may communicate mentally at the speed of thought. Allies farther than [Mind] km from you cannot hear or speak through the link. You can maintain up to X different links (X = times you know this Spell). Each link lasts until dismissed or you fall unconscious.

name: Summon Earthen Golem
description: You cause the earth itself to form a golem and fight by your side.
target: An empty space within [Sorcery or Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: You Summon an Earthen Golem in the target space, lasting for the encounter. When cast, you may commit this Spell; if you do, the Golem lasts as long as you keep this Spell committed or until you get a full night's rest.

name: Spirit Blessing
target: Yourself or an adjacent ally
effects: When you learn this, choose features that apply to the Spell (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 3 basic; Level 2: 4 basic; Level 3: 5 basic/advanced; Level 4: 6 basic/advanced.

name: Healing Magic
target: Yourself or an adjacent ally
effects: The target heals 1 Shallow Health, plus an extra Shallow Health for each Heart discarded. When you learn this, choose features that apply to the Spell (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 1 basic; Level 2: 4 basic; Level 3: 8 basic/advanced; Level 4: 11 basic/advanced.

name: From the Brink of Death
description: With small threads of power you stitch together someone's wounds just enough to stabilize them.
target: An adjacent ally who is Downed
effects: Your target heals 1 Deep Health.

name: Gust of Wind
target: All creatures within a 3-meter-long cone
effects: Make a Theurgy spell attack against the Dodge Defense of each target. Each target hit is Pushed back [twice your Mind] + [Spades] meters.

name: Beast Venom
target: A creature within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: Choose Crippling, Slowing, or Psychosis Poison. Make a Theurgy spell attack against the target's Vital Defense. If it hits, the target is affected by that Poison with Potency 3. Crippling gains +[Clubs] Potency, Slowing +[Spades], Psychosis +[Hearts].

name: Land's Bounty
description: A staple of druids living in small towns and communes, this incantation allows a druid to stoke the energy of the land and cause it to bear fruit in a heartbeat.
target: A circular area 2 meters in radius, centered on a space within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: All plant life in target spaces grows as though for an entire season. In most climates, affected terrain has [Mind] level of Difficult Terrain and additional effects may apply.

name: Lifeline
description: Extending your life force out to encompass a friend, you protect them from harm while taking the brunt of any attacks made against them.
action: 1 AP (may be used as an Interrupt when the target is hit by an attack)
target: An ally within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: The target is linked to you for the rest of the encounter. While linked, if the target would lose Health, instead you lose that much Health (target still suffers other effects). You may end the link at any time; it ends if you become Downed/incapacitated. When cast, you may commit it to make the link last until you uncommit.

name: Reckoning
target: A creature within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Theurgy spell attack against the target's Mental Defense. If it hits, they are Crippled 5 + [Clubs] times.

name: Sculpt Stone
description: You manipulate and shape the earth around you, allowing you to quickly break the earth to create barriers — or tear them down.
target: Up to [twice your Mind] square meters within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters (each space must be adjacent to earth or stone)
effects: You move earth into or out of the target spaces. A 1-meter barricade provides Light Cover; 2 meters provides Heavy or Total Cover. If you spend 10 minutes casting, it is not expended and you can shape the earth into walls, pillars, sculptures, or other structures (limited by Craft Skill Total for complex shapes).

name: Spectral Spiderwebs
target: Up to X + 1 creatures within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Theurgy spell attack against each target's Dodge Defense. If the attack hits, the target is Slowed 4 + [Spades] times. Discarded cards are counted in the attack's suit pool.

name: Summon Spectre
description: You summon a low-level shade, either bringing one from the Otherlands or forming one from ambient shadow energy.
target: An empty space within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: You Summon a Spectre in the target space, lasting for the encounter. When cast, you may commit this Spell; if you do, the Spectre lasts as long as you keep this Spell committed.

name: Weatherworking
description: Speaking to the earth, wind, and sky, you can wield the power of the weather itself.
action: 10 minutes (or 2 AP if you discard a card)
cost: Discard a card (to cast in 2 AP instead of 10 minutes)
target: An area [Mind] km in radius centered on you
effects: Change weather of the target area starting 3 rounds later, lasting for the encounter. Make a Theurgy flip; difficulty based on desired power: Minor (Diff 9): light rain/wind; Moderate (Diff 13): fog, thick clouds, Light Cover; Major (Diff 17): extreme effects, Heavy Cover, terrain alteration. Each Extra Success: expand area by [Mind] km or extend duration by 1 hour.

name: Cloak of Awe
description: Laying a mantle of flaring light over an ally, you stagger and shake enemies, driving them away from your friends.
target: Yourself or an ally within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Theurgy spell attack against the Mental Defense of each enemy within 3 meters of the target. The target Frightens each creature hit 3 + [Hearts] times.

name: Cloak of Command
description: Wrapping an ally with bands of compelling power, you draw your enemies' attention away from others and towards them instead.
target: Yourself or an ally within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Theurgy spell attack against the Mental Defense of each enemy within 3 meters of the target. The target Taunts each creature hit 3 + [Hearts] times.

name: Earthquake
description: Reaching into the depths of the earth with your power, you agitate the ground into a state of turmoil and uproar.
target: An area [Theurgy Skill Total] meters in radius, centered on a point within [twice Theurgy Skill Total] meters (no line of sight required)
effects: Create powerful tremors lasting for the encounter. All affected terrain has 1 level of Difficult Terrain. Any creature in the area when the Spell begins, moves/is Pushed into it, or ends their turn there is Crippled twice and Harried twice. At encounter's end, structures and terrain may suffer permanent damage.

name: Spiritual Intervention
description: As a sturdy boulder in the frantic storm of the world, you extend your magic to bend the fabric of existence itself.
effects: Choose another Theurgy Spell you know with Level no greater than 4 and taking no more than 2 AP to cast. This Spell has the same effects as that Spell; if that Spell has costs you must also pay them; that Spell is not expended.

name: War Magic
target: An adjacent creature
effects: Make a Sorcery spell attack against the target's Defense (Dodge or Vital, chosen when you learn this). If it hits, it deals 2 + [your Mind] Fire damage. When you learn this, choose features that apply (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 1 basic; Level 2: 3 basic; Level 3: 4 basic/advanced; Level 4: 6 basic/advanced.

name: Force Missiles
description: Even a basic understanding of the elemental arts allows a warmage to quickly barrage a foe with explosions of force.
target: A creature within [Sorcery Skill Total] meters
effects: Make a Sorcery spell attack against the target's Dodge or Parry Defense. The spell attack deals 3 + [Mind] Physical damage.

name: Gainsay
description: "Here we are at last, Conflagrator. We shall finally see, once and for all, whether my blade or your magic shall prove more nimble!"
action: 2 AP - Interrupt (A weapon attack is declared against you)
target: The creature attacking you
effects: Cast a Sorcery Spell against the target. The Spell cannot take more than 2 AP to cast.

name: Wall of Shadows
description: You conjure a wave of swirling, opaque shadow to obscure an area from sight.
target: Up to [Sorcery Skill Total] connected spaces, each within [Sorcery Skill Total] meters; each 3 meters tall
effects: You summon a wall of swirling shadows for the scene. Creatures cannot see through the wall or anything within it, but it is not solid. Attacks into or through the wall treat it as Heavy Cover.

name: Warmage's Reserves
description: At the Warmage's Garrison in the cosmopolitan City of Five Ports, multidisciplinary study of elemental magic has led to impressive advancements.
effects: Regain the use of a Sorcery Spell Encounter Technique with Level [X + 1] or less. X is increased by 1 for each Club discarded to this Technique.

name: Summon Elemental Warrior
description: Twisting elemental magic into solid form, you bring an elemental into being — a creature of energy and magic that you can command to destroy your enemies.
target: An empty space within [Sorcery Skill Total] meters
effects: You Summon an Elemental Warrior in the target space, lasting for the encounter. When cast, you may commit this Spell; if you do, the Elemental lasts as long as you keep this Spell committed.

name: Wall of Ice
description: With a wave of your arms you raise a cliff of solid ice, splitting a skirmish in two, or boxing in an unfortunate enemy.
target: Up to [Sorcery Skill Total] connected spaces within [Sorcery Skill Total] meters; each 3 meters tall
effects: You summon a wall of ice that lasts for the encounter. Creatures that would be in a space the wall occupies are moved to the nearest unoccupied adjacent space. Each space of wall has 4 Health and [Mind] Soak against all damage except Fire. When a space loses all Health, that section is destroyed.

name: Wall of Fire
description: You conjure a curtain of burning fire, threatening to incinerate anyone who passes through it.
target: Up to [Sorcery Skill Total] connected spaces within [Sorcery Skill Total] meters; each 3 meters tall
effects: You summon a wall of fire lasting for the scene. Creatures in the area when it begins may spend 1 AP (interrupt) to Shift 1 meter. Anyone in the area when the wall appears, moves/is Pushed into the area, or ends their turn there takes 3 + [your Mind] Fire damage.

name: Lawman's Hand
description: With some basic anatomic knowledge you know how to reliably incapacitate a foe instead of killing them.
effects: You do not suffer Bad Luck as usual for making non-lethal attacks.

name: Disciple of the Flowing Hand
description: Thanks to your training in the style of unarmored fighting, you easily flow like water around your weighed-down opponents.
effects: Attacks against your Dodge or Parry Defense have Bad Luck.

name: Furious Rage
description: You keep your bloodrage on a short leash, and at a moment's notice you can let loose and become a fearsome but reckless warrior.
effects: While in this Stance: You may not Parry. If a target Parries or is hit by one of your attacks, they gain a stack of Bleeding. Ignore any stacks of Taunted or Frightened you have. Ignore any penalties from being Wounded.

name: Hand of Chaos
description: Allowing your hand to be guided by the subtle winds of fate, your fighting sometimes turns up surprising results.
effects: Whenever you make an attack, Sift 1 card and add its suit to the pool.

name: Indomitable Phalanx
description: With a wide guard and intense focus, you can account for attacks from an entire squad of soldiers.
effects: At all times, you may ignore up to two stacks of Harried you have.

name: Placeholder's Lengthy Ley-weaving
description: "...the mighty Placeholder was so in-tune with the flow of magic that he could grasp the very lines of power that lie within the earth..."
effects: Your Spells and non-weapon-attack Disciplines have their Ranges increased by 3 meters.

name: Lion Style - Eternal Riposte
description: "Our pirates boarded the ship to find the crew hiding belowdecks, and a single woman standing before us..."
condition: You are wielding a non-shield weapon in one hand, and the other is empty
effects: As an Interrupt when you Parry an attack, choose one: (a) For 0 AP, make a weapon attack against the attacker. (b) For 1 AP, use a Technique that takes no more than 2 AP and has you make a weapon attack against the attacker but no other targets.

name: Shugen Style - Spirit Hands
description: A fundamental practice of the spiritual arts, you actively circulate your energy throughout your body to deliver powerful blows backed by spiritual power.
effects: If your Unarmed weapon attacks would deal Physical damage, they instead deal it as Brilliant damage.

name: Tiger Style - Storm of Blades
description: As a fighter perfects the art of two-weapon fighting, their style takes on a certain beauty.
condition: You are wielding two non-shield weapons
effects: Once per round immediately after you make an attack with one of your weapons (before anything else), you may spend 1 AP to make an identical attack with your other weapon, applying any ability (but not weapon) effects from the initial attack.

name: Eagle Eyes
description: Sharpening your focus for a moment, you guide each shot to your target with unerring precision.
effects: Whenever you take an action involving one or more attacks with a ranged weapon, you may spend an extra 1 AP. If you do, those attacks have Good Luck twice.

name: Follow Through
description: When your blows fell an enemy you can carry the force from the attack forward, striking another foe down.
condition: You are wielding a two-handed close-range weapon
effects: When one of your weapon attacks with a two-handed close-range weapon Downs a creature, you may immediately make an attack with that weapon against another creature next to the initial target.

name: Inexhaustible Guardian
description: As a pillar of courage and resilience on the battlefield, you never tire or falter under duress.
effects: Whenever you Parry an enemy's attack, gain 1 stack of Protected.

name: Overchanneling
description: Many styles of warmage training focus on overwhelming power and raw eldritch offense over all else.
effects: Your damaging spell attacks and non-weapon discipline attacks deal +1 damage. You may not Parry.
